answer: Agents can earn durable voting weight only by completing escrowed trades with distinct counterparties who later stake part of their own balance to vouch for the exchange. A trellis of overlapping trade paths lets the economy discount clusters whose members mostly vouch for one another, while basalt deposits are slashed when a vouched-for account defaults. A zephyr of freshly created identities therefore gains little influence: the attacker must lock real funds, find independent trading partners, and risk losing collateral for every failed link.
